facts.text: The resort is located about an hour from Casablanca Airport in Morocco.
facts.excerpt: Located just an hour from Casablanca Airport, Morocco

facts.text: The resort sprawls across 250 hectares with 7 kilometers of beachside.
facts.excerpt: Sprawling across 250 hectares & adorned with 7 kilometers of pristine beachside, Mazagan Beach & Golf Resort is a unique, eclectic and vibrant beach destination.

facts.text: Rooms and suites overlook the Grand Riad pool, gardens and forest, or the Atlantic Ocean.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking the Grand Riad pool, lush gardens and forest, or with sweeping vistas of the deep blue Atlantic Ocean

facts.text: Rooms and suites combine Moroccan tradition with contemporary design.
facts.excerpt: Where authentic Moroccan tradition and charm meets stylish contemporary design, each of the hotel’s rooms and suites offers you the complete Mazagan experience.

facts.text: Guests can choose from six distinct room types.
facts.excerpt: Select from six distinct room types, each meticulously crafted to accommodate your preferences

facts.text: Family rooms have views of the gardens, the golf course and the forest.
facts.excerpt: Experience the allure of family rooms boasting views of gardens, the golf course, and the forest, tailored for an authentic Moroccan holiday.

facts.text: Ground-floor Patio Family Rooms are available.
facts.excerpt: Ground-floor Patio Family Rooms offer captivating perspectives, ensuring a seamless Moroccan family getaway.

facts.text: The suites offer ample space and ocean views, suited to large families.
facts.excerpt: perfect for those craving elevated comfort, large families, or anyone in pursuit of upscale amenities, all complemented by breathtaking ocean vistas.

facts.text: The concierge can arrange restaurant or spa bookings, activities, and trips to Moroccan cities from Casablanca to Marrakech.
facts.excerpt: be it a restaurant or spa booking, an activity-packed afternoon or a trip to the cities and sights of Morocco from Casablanca to Marrakech and beyond

facts.text: The resort has 15 bars and restaurants.
facts.excerpt: Discover a premium selection of 15 signature bars and restaurants.

facts.text: Al Firma serves traditional Moroccan cuisine in a Berber tent, using organic, seasonal ingredients grown in the Al Firma garden.
facts.excerpt: savor the artful presentation of traditional Moroccan cuisine, crafted from organic and seasonal ingredients cultivated in the lush Al Firma garden

facts.text: Al Firma's Moroccan Nights feature Oriental dancers, Moroccan musicians and a campfire under the stars in a forest setting.
facts.excerpt: Experience the allure of Oriental dancers, the mesmerizing melodies of Moroccan musicians, and the captivating glow of a fire camp under the starlit sky, nestled in the heart of a breathtaking forest setting.

facts.text: The Beach Barbecue serves grilled dishes and cocktails on the sand facing the ocean.
facts.excerpt: Savor grilled delights, the day's fresh catch, and signature cocktails with your feet in the sand, facing the ocean.

facts.text: Studio 42's decor is inspired by the studios where scenes of the film Casablanca were filmed.
facts.excerpt: the decor is inspired by the studios where the most emblematic scenes of the legendary film “Casablanca” were filmed

facts.text: In July and August, Bushra by Buddha-Bar stages Le Show by Buddha-Bar with fire dancers in its tent-style restaurant.
facts.excerpt: the delightful nights of July and August come alive with the mesmerizing spectacle of Le Show by Buddha-Bar

facts.text: George is a steakhouse with ocean and golf course views.
facts.excerpt: Sink your teeth into the highest quality steak, while admiring the breathtaking ocean and golf course views.

facts.text: The Oasis Pool Restaurant and Bar sits at the heart of the resort overlooking the Grand Riad pool.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in the essence of holiday leisure at the heart of our resort, where the Oasis Pool Restaurant and Bar awaits, overlooking the majestic Grand Riad pool.

facts.text: Studio 42 lounge bar has an adults-only age policy and a smart casual dress code.
The resort calls itself the most iconic resort in Morocco.
facts.excerpt: The Most Iconic Resort in Morocco
